name: White Mulberry
desc: White Mulberry (Morus alba): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Morus alba, known as white mulberry, common mulberry and silkworm mulberry, is a fast-growing, small to medium-sized mulberry tree which grows to 10–20 m (33–66 ft) tall.
